capabilities: add .gitkeep files to every folder missing one
watch for newly created or renamed folders and add .gitkeep automatically
exclude configured paths such as .obsidian and .trash
show live counts of folders, exclusions, and .gitkeep files
disambiguation: Not a backup or sync tool; it only creates placeholder files so Git can track empty folders.
extras: Proprietary license; installation from source is described, with no marketplace install mentioned.
problem: Git does not track empty directories, so empty vault folders disappear when a repository is cloned elsewhere.
summary: Git helper that drops a .gitkeep placeholder file into every vault folder so empty directories survive in Git repositories.
